title: Gate-Claim Diviner
text: Gate-Claim Diviner reads ownership in the vibrations of locked hinges and declares every gate Court property. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: A closed door is merely a verdict waiting to speak.

defeatReward.text: Gate-Claim Diviner is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
